scoring_justification: Agent-reported derived parameters are compared to paper-reported reference values; recomputing from raw artifacts is infeasible as the raw input measurements are not in the artifact and implementing the full SPB model with Hall factor equations in a lightweight checker is complex.

outputs.description: The scored artifact containing the extracted Fermi level, scattering parameter, carrier concentration, carrier mobility, and power factor for both samples.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for transport parameters from Table 1 of the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the published paper's derived parameters for P3HT and P3HT-Bi2Te3 samples.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported results for the same samples and conditions.
